Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Quick note |
|---|-------|------|------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick’s psychological nightmare based on Stephen King’s novel. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | A chilling family saga that blends supernatural dread with raw emotional trauma. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Jordan Peele’s sharp satire of racism wrapped in a suspenseful thriller. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | A tense survival story where silence is the only way to stay alive. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | A daylight horror that turns a Swedish festival into a nightmarish ritual. |
| 6 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | Paranormal investigators Ed & Lorraine Warren tackle a haunted farmhouse. |
| 7 | **It Follows** | 2014 | A modern folk‑tale about a curse that can’t be escaped. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | An Australian psychological horror that explores grief and motherhood. |
| 9 | **The Witch** | 2015 | A slow‑burning, period‑piece horror set in 1630s New England. |
|10 | **Suspiria (2018)** | 2018 | Luca Guadagnino’s remake of Dario Argento’s cult classic, with a haunting score. |
|11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | An American remake of the Japanese horror film, featuring a cursed videotape. |
|12 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Found‑footage horror that builds tension through everyday domestic life. |
|13 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | A meta‑take on horror tropes that starts as a typical “cabin” story. |
|14 | **The Others** | 2001 | Nicole Kidman stars in a gothic tale of ghosts and secrets. |
|15 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | The quintessential exorcism film that still terrifies audiences today. |

Feel free to pick any that match your mood—whether you want a psychological thriller, supernatural chills, or a fresh take on classic tropes!
